about: Data of Learn case file CF4 (wave W6, 2026-11-07). The timeline and the boundary card are approved E15 wording (Henry, 2026-11-07; reports/learn/excerpts_for_approval.md, W6 sources), word for word (E15.26, E15.27, E15.25); the boundary card's source line is E15.30. The idea is the course's own toy: a generic existing plant with round numbers, some of them the reader's, for one illustrative day; nothing in it is the study's input, equation or result.

timeline.title: The study in time
timeline.lede: Two dated steps: the journal article and its open code.

events.label: Journal article (this case)
events.text: Hourly operation of 42 existing reactors with high-temperature electrolysis, hydrogen storage and batteries, in seven U.S. ISO/RTO markets at 2024 prices, is linked to a lifetime cash-flow model; published online on 2 June 2026.

events.label: Code released
events.text: A documented, runnable implementation of the modelling framework, with synthetic examples (version 1.0.0).

boundary.title: Where the result holds
holds: 42 existing plants in seven U.S. ISO/RTO markets, each at its own 2024 hourly prices, taken as given;
one year of hourly operation (8,760 hours) turned into a lifetime cash flow;
the existing plant's capital treated as already spent, so the capital counted is that of the new hydrogen and battery equipment;
the assumed hydrogen production credit ($3/kg for ten years) in the retrofit results shown here, with the dispatch held fixed after it expires;
no credits in the baseload case;
leaves: re-optimized operation after the credit expires.
boundary.source: Approved excerpt of: Li et al. (2026), Nature Communications.

scale.markText: Its reach: plants across a nation's markets. Its model works one plant at a time, as at S0.

idea.title: One day at an existing plant that can also make hydrogen
idea.note: Illustrative round numbers, some of them yours: a generic existing plant, not the study's inputs or results. Power in MW, as an average over each hour; money in dollars for the one day shown.
